articles.title: Pakistan seeks $10 billion US stabilization facility to shore up reserves
articles.description: Pakistan has requested a ten billion dollar exchange stabilization facility from the United States. This loan aims to bolster foreign exchange reserves and ease pressure on the Pakistani rupee. The request follows Pakistan's diplomatic efforts in brokering talks over the Iran war. This facility would reduce reliance on multilateral financing and IMF programs. It also seeks to deepen bilateral economic cooperation and attract U.S. investment.

articles.title: Sebi directs depositories to freeze promoter holdings during buyback period, new rules explained
articles.description: Sebi has directed depositories to freeze promoter holdings during company buyback periods. This restriction will be in effect from board approval until the offer closes. Promoters can still participate in buybacks through the tender offer route. Existing pledges created before the buyback period can also be invoked. Depositories must implement these operational systems by August 1.

articles.title: Rupee rallies 21 paise to 96.24 against US dollar on lower oil prices and forex inflows
articles.description: The rupee strengthened by twenty-one paise, closing at ninety-six point twenty-four on Tuesday. Lower oil prices reduced demand for the US dollar, supporting the local currency. Dedicated programs aimed at drawing forex inflows have garnered nearly twenty-one billion dollars. State-run banks sold dollars, providing support around ninety-six point forty-two levels. The currency traded within a narrow range throughout the trading session.

articles.title: Sebi unveils simpler rules for mutual fund transmission claims
articles.description: Mutual fund unit transmission is now simpler for nominees and joint holders. Asset management companies will rely on the latest address with valid documents. A harmonised framework addresses name and signature mismatches effectively. Surviving joint holders or nominees submit a death certificate and bank details. The process is completed within five to fifteen working days.

articles.title: India ran a $4-trillion economy half-blind for decades. That just ended
articles.description: For decades, India has tracked factory, mining, and electricity output every month through the Index of Industrial Production, even though services account for more than half of the economy. That gap has finally begun to close. The government has released monthly production indices for 19 service industries, using GST returns and regulatory data to estimate changes in real output. This could transform GDP forecasting, monetary-policy analysis, and investment research. But it is still only a trial series.

articles.title: One97 Communications to infuse ₹100 cr in wealth tech arm Paytm Money
articles.description: Fintech firm One97 Communications, which owns the Paytm brand, plans to infuse Rs 100 crore in its wealth tech arm Paytm Money, the company said in a regulatory filing. Incorporated in 2017, Paytm Money is engaged in providing investment and wealth management services, including stock broking, mutual fund distribution, and other financial services. "Additional investment by the company, by way of subscription, to the equity shares of its wholly owned subsidiary, namely Paytm Money Limited (PML) by way of a rights issue for an amount up to Rs 100 crore, subject to the necessary approvals, as applicable," Paytm said in a late-night filing on Monday. The company expects to close the transaction by September 30. "PML is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company. Issuance of up to 10 crore (Ten crore) additional equity shares of face value of Rs 10 each by PML, pursuant to the Rights Issue, will not result in a change in shareholding of the company in PML, which remains at 100 per cent,"
